generation_source: assistant visually selected 431 T3 polylines, bounded optical flow, local cross-section ridge fitting; not independently manual labels
apparent_width_unit: native T1 pixel; not physical diameter
uncertain_colour_or_viability: left unclassified; absence or browning alone does not establish death
source_reference_limitation: T3-guided traces can miss roots visible only in another period; water and soil texture may still cause false positives. Check original RGB, entire root width and each period before declaring an image complete.
root_ids: provisional geometric trace IDs, not validated biological root identities
